view.sqlSentence: SELECT CAST(CONCAT(YEAR(invoice.issue_date), "/", LPAD(MONTH(invoice.issue_date),2,"0")) AS CHAR), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM invoice, invoice_detail, invoice_tax WHERE invoice.id = invoice_detail.invoice AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?,"-",?,"-",1), "%Y-%m-%d"), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?,"-",? + 1,"-",1), "%Y-%m-%d"), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
